V. 51.
If a man keep my word—So will my Father conſult my Glory. We keep his Doctrine by believing, his Promiſes by hoping his Son 〈…〉 by obeying. He ſhall never ſee death—That is, Death eternal. He ſhall live for ever. Hereby He proves, that He was no Samaritan. For the Samaritans in general were Sadducees.
